name: mirage
text: The AU1 session is running. It started about 15:37 UTC and is working on its own branch. So far it has refreshed the star-evidence table and added a test for the app's JSON file store, which is the large-file-writes area. Nothing is released yet. It's a big job (audit, fixes, full test run, release), so expect a few hours. I'll post here when the release is out.
